author: everestmcarthur
description: The ultimate Discord event logging system. Captures every single Discord event with individual toggles, advanced filtering, customizable formats (detailed/compact/JSON), comprehensive tracking of all Discord gateway events, and intelligent attachment/media logging with image/GIF/video previews and deleted attachment recovery.
install_msg: Thanks for installing RubyLogging! Use `[p]rlog quickstart #channel` to get started with attachment logging enabled, or `[p]rlog list` to see all 100+ available events. Media logging automatically tracks and previews images, GIFs, videos, and stickers - even after deletion!
short: Ultimate event logger - every Discord event, individually toggleable, with intelligent media tracking
